upgrade_checkpoint_version: upgrade a mmdetection checkpoint file from an older version to the latest version
convert_checkpoint_keys: convert checkpoint keys to match the current mmdetection model architecture
reorder_classification_channels: reorder classification channel ordering in a checkpoint to fix class index mismatches
truncate_regression_channels: truncate regression channels in a checkpoint to match the target number of classes
truncate_mask_prediction_channels: truncate mask prediction channels in a checkpoint to match the target number of classes
